band_origin.easy: Authored easy complete-calculation practice using small source-supported forms and full-answer choices. The learner must choose the substitution; no primitive or substitution is provided.
band_origin.moderate: Full calculation with source-supported families and small parameters; mastered prerequisite formulas and routine endpoint values are recalled.
band_origin.hard: Authored relative band: Transform bounds for a logarithmic derivative; exponential endpoint facts recalled. Ordinary practice retrieves mastered prerequisites.

calibration: Source-informed authored task progression, not psychometric calibration or inherited source difficulty.
response: Inverse-trig antiderivatives use complete five-choice banks with factor and argument errors; native free-entry inverse functions are unsupported. Other full calculations use exact blanks, external C for indefinite results.
support: All bands assess complete calculation and recognition of the substitution. Easy uses complete-answer choices and small forms. Moderate uses exact entry where supported. No substitution, primitive or routine endpoint reminders appear before answering. Domain assumptions remain; worked solutions explain every step.
parameter_policy: Integer amplitudes 1..4, inverse scale integers 2..5 or their ratios, perfect-square constants at most25; exponential slopes magnitude at most2 and powers at most3. Hard adds one target condition.
sampling: Seeded family-first sampling; no duplicates within batch; exclude existing integrands for full calculations. Easy transformations are a distinct task and may share an imported full-calculation integrand.
answer_policy: External C for indefinite blanks; all worked solutions finish with the exact key. No mandatory decimal padding.
